findings.chapter: Chapter 7 — Memory Is the First Constraint
findings.evidence: “For reference, the 9.5K total at this byte-halving basis is ~152 GB — still above a single H100, but now within 2×H100, 160 GB.”
findings.issue: This aggregate-capacity statement can be misread as a fit verdict. The chapter’s own per-rank test for 2×H100 fails: each rank would hold ~70 GB of weights + ~6.225 GB of FP8 KV + ~32 GB reserve = ~108.2 GB > 80 GB. Saying “within 2×H100, 160 GB” without repeating the per-rank failure is inconsistent with the chapter’s three-gate fit discipline.
findings.fix_instruction: Add “aggregate only” and state that the per-rank test still fails on 2×H100 at the stated reserve, or remove the “within 2×H100” phrase. Reconcile with Table 7-1’s “Conditional Pass” language.

findings.chapter: Ch 7 — Memory Is the First Constraint
findings.evidence: "Its language configuration has 16 full-attention layers, four KV-heads per layer, and a head dimension of 256 (released configuration, retrieved 2026-10-28). With BF16 KV storage, the raw component is: 2 × 16 × 4 × 256 × 2 = 65,536 bytes per cached token. At 262,144 cached tokens, this component occupies 16 GiB."
findings.issue: The arithmetic is internally correct (65,536 B/token × 262,144 tokens = 17,179,869,184 B = 16 GiB exactly), but the unit is stated in GiB while every other capacity figure in Ch. 7 is stated in decimal GB (the chapter locks the unit basis explicitly: 'the H100's quoted 80 GB is treated as decimal 80×10^9 B throughout, so the canonical 8×H100 pool reads 640 GB'). Mixing a GiB capacity into a chapter that has declared a decimal-GB basis, for a figure that is not itself a capacity gate, invites the reader to compare 16 GiB (17.18 GB) against the 640 GB decimal pool without the conversion. The same subsection then says 'At 131,072 tokens the same component is 8 GiB'.
findings.fix_instruction: State the 16 GiB figure in the chapter's locked decimal basis (≈17.18 GB) or add an explicit parenthetical noting the binary unit and its decimal equivalent, so the figure is comparable to the 640 GB decimal pool used everywhere else in the chapter.

findings.chapter: Front matter / Ch 7 (Memory Is the First Constraint)
findings.evidence: List of Tables, PDF p.11: 'Table 7-2 Memory floors by regime: inference and fine-tuning . . . 143'. Actual location: caption 'Table 7-2 — Memory floors by regime: inference and fine-tuning variants for the canonical 80-layer, hidden-8192, full-MHA 70B reference model.' is the last block of PDF p.165 (header '141'), and the first body row ('regime | scenario | memory resident | bytes per param | total (70B) | fits 8xH100') opens PDF p.166 (header '142'). Offset of 24 between PDF and printed pages is confirmed by the rendered image of printed p.139 (Fig 7.1 = PDF p.163) and by PDF p.165's own '141' header.
findings.issue: Stale page number in the List of Tables: Table 7-2 is listed at printed p.143 but its caption begins on printed p.141 and its body on p.142 — a 2-page drift. The neighboring Table 7-1 entry (p.134) is correct, so the error is isolated, and every other List entry verifiable in the extracted range (Tables 1-1 through 7-1; Figs P.1 through 7.2) resolves correctly.
findings.fix_instruction: Regenerate the List of Tables entry for Table 7-2 to point at the caption page (printed 141), and re-audit the remaining Chapter 7+ list entries (Tables 7-3, 8-1, 9-1, ...) against the final build since the drift starts in this chapter.
